notes: BETA 2.29.91. NEW: F1 25 support, including the 2026 Season Pack (the new UDP format 2026 with all 24 cars) - in the game turn on UDP Telemetry (port 20777, UDP Format 2025 or 2026). NEW: first support for Automobilista 2 - in the game set Options > System > Shared Memory to Project CARS 2; you get the whole field (gaps, names, positions), flags incl. full course yellow, fuel strategy, damage, current weather, spotter and the track map. F1: safety car and VSC are called as full course yellow, red flag, drive-through and stop-go penalties, damage, off-track, the whole grid for 'how far to P5', and fuel advice now knows there is no refuelling in F1 (save fuel instead of 'box for fuel'). F1 24 fixes: races are recognised as races again (gaps and rival calls work) and rival names are no longer scrambled. All games: values from the previous game (mandatory stops, TC/ABS, standings) no longer carry over into the next one. Also in this beta: the setup advisor reworked from real setup guides, incl. the LMU/rF2 tyre pressure advice. F1 25 and Automobilista 2 have NOT been tested with the real games yet - please tell us on Discord if the top bar says CONNECTED, if gaps and names match the game, and if the map and car left/right calls are the right way round.
